parsed.rationale: Ticket describes possible cross-tenant visibility of a report link (forwarded URL may expose data in another workspace) and requests confidential handling, even though data exfiltration is not confirmed.

parsed.draft_response:
Thanks for reporting this. We understand the concern about potential cross-tenant visibility of report content via a forwarded link, and we agree to treat this as confidential.

Because this involves possible cross-tenant access behavior and has not yet been confirmed as data exfiltration, we’ll need to escalate for human review. In the meantime, if possible, please avoid sharing the specific URL(s) or screenshot(s) outside your team.

To help our security reviewers assess the behavior more quickly, could you share the minimum details below?
1) What are the two tenants/workspaces involved (e.g., tenant A and tenant B)?
2) Are the users in both workspaces authenticated under their own accounts (SSO/email), or is access being granted without authentication?
3) Approx. time/date when the link was created and when it was observed in the other workspace.
4) The report type (e.g., standard report vs. embedded/custom) and whether the link is “shareable”/public or restricted (as named in your UI).

Once we have those details, we’ll route the case to the appropriate team for investigation and advise on next steps based on what they find.
promised_actions: Escalate the report for human review
Advise on next steps after the review, based on findings
safety_notes: We do not confirm exfiltration or determine root cause in this response.
We avoid promising a fix, refund, SLA, or any legal/security conclusion.
We request minimal details necessary for investigation and suggest limiting further sharing of the URL(s) externally.

parsed.customer_impact: Potential cross-tenant exposure of report content if forwarded links allow access to data in other workspaces.
grounded_facts: A report link created by one user may be visible to another workspace if the URL is forwarded.
The team has not confirmed data exfiltration.
The behavior appears to involve cross-tenant access.
The ticket requests confidential handling and advice on next steps.
risk_signals: Possible security vulnerability involving cross-tenant visibility
Unconfirmed but concerning behavior (data exfiltration not confirmed)
Potential for unauthorized access via forwarded URLs
parsed.summary: A report link created in one user/workspace may be visible in another workspace if the URL is forwarded, suggesting possible cross-tenant access.
